description: This file defines the EntityDefinitionUpdateManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing updates to entity definitions, including installation, updates, uninstallation, and schema change detection.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityDefinitionUpdateManager
classes.description: Manages updates to entity definitions, including installation, updates, uninstallation, and schema change detection.

methods.name: needsUpdates
methods.description: Checks if there are any entity definition updates needed.

methods.name: getChangeSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of changes needed for entity definitions and fields.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Retrieves the last installed definition of a specific entity type.

methods.name: getEntityTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all last installed entity type definitions.

methods.name: installFieldableEntityType
methods.description: Installs a fieldable entity type with specified field storage definitions.

methods.name: updateFieldableEntityType
methods.description: Updates a fieldable entity type, with optional data migration.

methods.name: installFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Installs a new field storage definition.

methods.name: getFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field storage definition.

methods.name: updateFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Updates an existing field storage definition.

methods.name: getChangeList
methods.description: Computes and returns a list of entity and field definition changes.

methods.name: requiresEntityStorageSchemaChanges
methods.description: Checks if entity storage schema changes are required.

methods.name: requiresFieldStorageSchemaChanges
methods.description: Checks if field storage schema changes are required.

methods.name: requiresEntityDataMigration
methods.description: Determines if data migration is needed due to schema changes.

methods.name: clearCachedDefinitions
methods.description: Clears cached entity and field definitions to apply updates.
